content.value: Task 3: Your Company will purchase a parcel of land in next month for BDT 750 (10) million. For how much will your company have to sell the property in 15 years to earn a 10% annual return on bth initial outlay and expected annual payment of 8.5 million for property tax and evelopment to the land? Assume these funds could be invested at comparable risk to earn a 10 percent annual return.
